classes.name: LeaveOverlapParams
classes.description: A Data Transfer Object (DTO) for leave overlap parameters, providing methods that throw exceptions for unsupported operations.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type as an integer, but throws a LogicException indicating the operation is not allowed.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type. This implementation does nothing, possibly indicating it's controlled elsewhere.

methods.name: getComment
methods.description: Returns a comment string or null, but throws a LogicException indicating the operation is not permitted.

methods.name: setComment
methods.description: Sets a comment, but the method body is empty, indicating no operation.

methods.name: getLogicException
methods.description: Creates and returns a LogicException indicating that the operation is not allowed for this class.
